title: Decider-Assisted Agentic API Gateway
problem_statement: Traditional LLM chains spend hundreds of milliseconds and high token costs routing incoming customer tickets. Build an intelligent gateway using Strands Decider 2B for sub-30ms intent dispatch and Bedrock for final generation.
key_features: Sub-50ms intent and tool routing via Strands Decider 2B wire protocol
Dynamic prompt injection with calibrated confidence scoring
Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 3.5 synthesis for complex generative tasks
Dockerized microservice deployment with telemetry and latency trace metrics
implementation_milestones: Week 1: Design typed System One questions and define criteria maps
Week 2: Implement FastAPI dispatch middleware with Strands Decider client
Week 3: Integrate Amazon Bedrock fallback and generative enrichment
Week 4: Write test suite and containerize for AWS App Runner

title: Autonomous Career Intelligence Copilot
problem_statement: Engineering students get overwhelmed by career roadmaps. Construct an end-to-end interactive career copilot featuring live decision trace visualization, skill gap radar analysis, and dynamic roadmaps.
key_features: Interactive Decision Trace panel showing live model probabilities and confidence
Deterministic skill gap evaluator linked with personalized roadmap generator
Strands Agents SDK intervention handlers guarding tool executions
Responsive dark-mode UI with Recharts and Lucide icons
implementation_milestones: Week 1: Core decision engine and Pydantic schemas
Week 2: Strands Agents integration with Bedrock service
Week 3: React Vite dashboard, decision lab, and career workspace
Week 4: End-to-end testing, documentation, and AWS deployment guide

title: Serverless Micro-RAG Document Assistant
problem_statement: College departments need instant, citation-backed answers on course syllabi, lab guidelines, and exam schedules without expensive dedicated vector servers.
key_features: Hybrid dense and lexical search on course catalogs
Amazon Bedrock Titan embeddings paired with Claude Sonnet response synthesis
Strict provenance citations with chunk boundary highlights
FastAPI endpoint with rate limiting and AWS IAM role authentication
implementation_milestones: Week 1: Document chunking and embedding generation pipeline
Week 2: Vector search indexing and query retrieval orchestration
Week 3: API endpoints and automated evaluation benchmarks

title: Interactive Code Review & Vulnerability Triage Bot
problem_statement: Open-source maintainers receive dozens of pull requests daily. Automate fast initial security and code smell triage before calling heavyweight models.
key_features: Strands Decider 2B fast binary classification of PR security risks
Calibrated confidence thresholds triggering human-in-the-loop alerts
Automated GitHub comment reporting with suggested refactor diffs
implementation_milestones: Week 1: Webhook receiver and AST parser for diff extraction
Week 2: Decider prompt engineering for vulnerability detection
Week 3: GitHub PR integration and performance benchmarks
